BY virtue of the powers vested in me, under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No.02 of1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning and Water Supply, do hereby approve the acquisition of theimmovable property, described in the following Schedule as it is required by the National Water Supply and DrainageBoard, for construction of Kurukudegama Water Treatment Plant and official bungalow under Bandarawela-DiyathalawaIntegrated Water Supply Project.
